scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong industry match is available
focus: Organ-on-chip and complex in vitro/preclinical models
scope.selection_rule: Current actionable roles only; stale or expired postings excluded from this snapshot.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Complex In Vitro Model
jobs.company_info: AbbVie Immunology's Complex In Vitro Model group supports inflammatory and autoimmune drug discovery using human-relevant systems.
jobs.posting_status: Active employer posting with Apply button
jobs.job_description: Design and interpret drug-potency and mechanism studies using primary human cells, organoids, organ-on-chip and other complex in vitro systems.
key_must_have_requirements: Primary human immune-cell and tissue culture
ELISA/MSD, PCR, multicolor flow cytometry and high-content microscopy
jobs.why_good_match: The closest direct industry translation of the user's Crohn's organoid/chip work: inflammatory biology, advanced human models and mechanistic assay development are central duties.
likely_gaps: Role is written around BS/MS plus substantial industry-style experience rather than a new PhD
Primary immune-cell and multicolor flow depth may be weaker than organoid/chip expertise
jobs.tailor: Lead with Crohn's patient-derived organoids, host-microbiome chip models, barrier/ROS/inflammation assays, confocal imaging and quantitative validation. Translate publications into assay-development and decision-enabling outcomes.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply now with an industry resume; mirror the posting's complex-in-vitro, inflammatory-disease, assay-robustness and high-content-imaging language.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist — Advanced Human Model Systems
jobs.company: National Center to Accelerate Cures / Blackbird Laboratories
jobs.company_info: NCAC is building infrastructure to validate and standardize New Approach Methodologies for regulatory decision-making.
jobs.job_description: Implement externally developed organoid and organ-on-chip platforms, standardize workflows, benchmark performance, develop SOPs and support NAM validation studies.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD with typically 4+ years relevant experience
Hands-on experience across advanced human model systems
jobs.why_good_match: It converts organ-chip expertise into the rarer NAM validation/regulatory-translation lane and would differentiate the user's future independent research profile.
likely_gaps: Limited formal GLP/GCLP/GMP and audit-ready validation experience
jobs.tailor: Emphasize platform transfer, PDMS fabrication QC, reproducibility, SOP development, comparative validation and human-relevant model context-of-use rather than only disease biology.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply as a stretch and explicitly position doctoral platform ownership as equivalent advanced-model implementation experience.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Bioprinting
jobs.company_info: Polbionica develops advanced 3D bioprinting technologies and regenerative-medicine platforms and is expanding at LabCentral.
jobs.job_description: Hands-on biotechnology and regenerative-medicine research using 3D bioprinting; prior dedicated bioprinting experience is not required when adjacent tissue-engineering/cell-culture experience is strong.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong laboratory biotechnology/cell culture/tissue engineering background
jobs.why_good_match: The user's PDMS microfabrication, 3D printing, organoid culture and engineered-tissue background provide a credible bridge into biofabrication without requiring an already-established bioprinting track record.
likely_gaps: Limited direct bioink and automated bioprinter experience
jobs.tailor: Use a fabrication-forward resume and portfolio showing membrane fabrication, device iteration, organoid/chip images and quantitative QC.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply before October 3 and attach a compact visual engineering portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Scientist (3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering)
jobs.company_info: CTIBIOTECH USA is scaling a preclinical CRDMO platform around industrialized human tissue engineering and 3D bioprinting.
jobs.posting_status: Active; expires September 22, 2026; no visa sponsorship
jobs.job_description: Lead hands-on 3D-bioprinted tissue production, primary human cell processing, client ADME-Tox/efficacy assays, documentation and GxP-oriented laboratory execution.
jobs.why_good_match: Strong overlap with primary cells, tissue engineering, microfluidics and translational preclinical model operation.
jobs.tailor: Emphasize reproducibility, SOPs, troubleshooting, primary-cell handling, device fabrication and assay execution; de-emphasize purely academic novelty.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply before September 22 if sponsorship is not required; ask early about R&D ownership versus production workload.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist — NGS Assay Development
jobs.company_info: Pillar develops targeted NGS assays for oncology and other human genomic applications.
jobs.posting_status: Active; posted September 8 and closes October 8, 2026
jobs.job_description: Develop, evaluate and troubleshoot reproducible bioinformatics analyses supporting targeted NGS assay development in collaboration with wet-lab, product, regulatory and clinical teams.
jobs.why_good_match: A credible computational pivot because the role values wet-lab assay understanding and technical troubleshooting, not just isolated algorithm development.
likely_gaps: Production-grade software/pipeline engineering may be less developed than scRNA/HUMAnN analysis
jobs.tailor: Lead with reproducible Seurat/scRNA and metagenomics workflows, assay-linked biological interpretation and debugging; quantify datasets and pipeline outputs.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply only with a computation-forward resume and a GitHub/code portfolio that demonstrates reproducibility.
